claim: During NREM sleep (N2 and N3), the levels of ACh and monoamines such as HA and NE are reduced compared to the awake state.
source: Compared to the awake state, in N2 and N3, the levels of ACh and monoamines such as HA and NE are reduced while the level of the inhibitory neurotransmitter GABA is increased (Aston-Jones and Bloom, 1981); (McCormick, 1992; Vazquez and Baghdoyan, 2001; Lena et al., 2005; Vanini et al., 2011).

claim: During NREM sleep (N2 and N3), the level of the inhibitory neurotransmitter GABA is increased compared to the awake state.

evidence: The claim is supported by multiple citations to prior experimental work.

claim: During REM sleep, the level of ACh is increased compared to NREM sleep.
